title: Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love is a mature young man, "awesome with the locker room"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love is a mature young man, "awesome with the locker room"
sources.description: "He's been awesome with the locker room. He is himself, but he also has some awareness that he's a rookie," LaFleur said.
